items.title: Expeditors International (EXPD) Is Up 5.2% After EPS Gains And Completing 70% Share Buyback Program - Has The Bull Case Changed?
items.summary: In the second quarter of 2026, Expeditors International of Washington reported revenue of US$3,502.34 million and net income of US$266.23 million, with earnings per share rising from a year earlier. Over the first half of 2026, the company also completed a long-running buyback program initiated in 2001, having repurchased more than 70% of its shares for about US$9.37 billion in total.
